discovery: The gauge/gravity (AdS/CFT) holographic duality between quantum field theory and quantum gravity

nominees.name: Juan Maldacena
nominees.affiliation: Institute for Advanced Study, Princeton, USA

nominees.name: Edward Witten
nominees.affiliation: Institute for Advanced Study, Princeton, USA

motivation: Maldacena's 1997 conjecture that strongly coupled large-N gauge theories are exactly equivalent to string theory in anti-de Sitter space was turned into a precise, calculable dictionary by Witten and by Polyakov (with Gubser and Klebanov). Holography is the most concrete realisation we have of a non-perturbative quantum theory of gravity. It shows that spacetime and gravity can emerge from ordinary quantum degrees of freedom, and that black holes evolve unitarily. It has reorganised theoretical physics well beyond string theory. It gives quantitative tools for strongly coupled quark-gluon plasma, including the viscosity bound probed at RHIC and the LHC, for strange metals and quantum criticality, and for quantum chaos. It also founded the field linking quantum information to spacetime geometry, through holographic entanglement entropy, quantum error correction and the black hole information problem. Few ideas since quantum field theory itself have opened so many new questions across physics.
